# `company.bank_feed_accounts`

What each feed account last received: the bank number, last four account digits and kind an OFX file carried, checked against every later file.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | accounts.id | The account. |
| `bank_number` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | The bank's routing number the account's OFX files carry (BANKID); null for a card or when none was given. |
| `account_last4` | VARCHAR(4) | yes | — | — | — | — | Last four characters of the OFX ACCTID the account receives. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(8) | yes | — | — | — | — | Statement kind the files carry: bank, card. |
| `last_import_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | bank_feed_imports.id | The account's newest import. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time of the last change. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version. |
